sentences.text:
This fourth application under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed for grant of bail to applicant in connection with Crime No.114/2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 363 and 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, registered at Police Station- Sumawali,
District Morena.
T h e applicant is in judicial custody since 28.03.2022 in the aforementioned case.
The allegation against him is that he kidnapped the prosecutrix, who is aged about 17 years, and committed rape with her.

sentences.text: The applicant was earlier granted the benefit of bail subject to the outcome of the FSL report.
Thereafter, the FSL report came which reveal that there were semen stains in the artifacts given to the FSL.
Thereafter, he surrendered and has been languishing in prison ever since.
Earlier, on merits, the case has been dismissed.
Present application is only being pressed on the grounds of delay in trial.
Evidence is still continuing and learned counsel for the applicant submits that 10 witnesses are yet to be examined and 13 witnesses have already been examined.
Amongst the witnesses, the prosecutrix, her mother, father and her sister have all turned hostile and have not supported the case of the prosecution.
They all stated that the prosecutrix actually went to Gujarat to the house of her brother who brought her back to her parental home.

Learned counsel for the State on the other hand submits that the FSL report reveals semen stains in the artifacts of the prosecutrix forwarded for examination and therefore, the role of the applicant,
notwithstanding the fact that the witnesses have turned hostile, is to no avail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the applicant submits that where all the witnesses have turned hostile including the prosecutrix, her mother, father and her sister and they have all stated that the prosecutrix was never with the applicant but was in the house of her brother from where she was brought back to her parental home, the presence of semen in the artifacts taken from the prosecutrix could be of any other man.
The DNA report has still not been received.
However, the applicant is still in judicial custody since 28.3.2022.
In view of the above, on the grounds of delay in trial for which the applicant cannot be held liable as he is still in custody, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant herein shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ATUL SREEDHARAN) JUDGE AKS Ramveer Kadera vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83519197/
